title: Cash Flow Rush
premise: A neon-styled arcade survival game where a cute wallet avatar moves around the screen to grab falling money while dodging dangerous tax slips.
interaction_model: Real-time pointer or touch control on a full-screen canvas, with the player dragging or tapping to steer the wallet smoothly toward a target position.
objective: Collect as much money as possible, survive for as long as possible, and avoid losing all three lives to falling tax hazards.
progression: The run begins immediately, objects fall faster and spawn more aggressively over time, score increases through money pickups, and the session ends after three hazard collisions before allowing a restart.
theme: Playful futuristic personal-finance arcade action with neon cyber-city styling.
mood: Energetic, glossy, slightly comedic, and high-pressure in a light arcade way.
likely_audience: Casual arcade players, mobile-friendly web players, and players who enjoy short score-attack reflex games with simple controls.
confidence_notes: High confidence that the core loop is collect-good-items and avoid-bad-items under rising speed pressure.
High confidence that the player avatar is intentionally represented as a wallet mascot and the hazards are tax-themed penalties.
Medium confidence on exact genre naming because the game borrows endless-runner survival pacing without lane-based movement.
recreation_prompt: Create a polished mobile-friendly HTML5 arcade game called "Cash Flow Rush" presented as a single-screen neon financial dodge-and-collect experience. The player controls a cute wallet mascot on a full-screen canvas by touching, clicking, or dragging anywhere on the play area, and the wallet should glide smoothly toward the pointer rather than snapping instantly. From the top of the screen, three main object types fall downward with slight drift and rotation: regular cash bills worth a modest score reward, rare gold coins worth a much larger bonus, and dangerous red tax slips that remove one life on contact. The goal is to survive as long as possible while collecting money and maximizing a visible dollar total. Start the player with three lives, show the current score in a bold futuristic HUD at the top, and display remaining lives as stylized icons beneath it. Increase tension over time by gradually making the game faster and spawning objects more frequently, so each run becomes harder the longer the player lasts. Add strong audiovisual feedback: pickup sounds, a harsher hit sound, looping background music during play, floating score text, particles on collisions, brief reward and fail reaction overlays, and optional vibration on supported devices. Use a dark sci-fi city-night backdrop with glowing cyan, mint, and gold highlights, and make the wallet avatar expressive and charming. When all lives are lost, freeze play and show a game-over overlay with the final money total and a single restart button so the session can immediately begin again.
